caseNameFull: Ohio Bureau of Employment Services v. Hodory

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. N. D. Ohio. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 814.] Motion of appellants for leave to allocate time to the Chamber of Commerce of the United States to argue as amicus curiae denied. Motion of Local No. 1375, United Steel Workers of America, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied.
